parameters.content:
## Tell the owner when a customer texts STOP, START or HELP
Twilio blocks texts to anyone who replies STOP, but nobody tells the business. This workflow sits on your Twilio number, answers Twilio right away without replying to the customer, and texts you the moment someone opts out, opts back in or asks for help. It can also forward every other text to your cell and send opt-outs to your CRM.

### How it works
1. Twilio sends each incoming text to the webhook.
2. A Code node sorts it. If Twilio's Advanced Opt-Out recognised a keyword, it uses Twilio's OptOutType. Otherwise it matches Twilio's default keywords against the whole message.
3. Twilio gets an empty reply, so the customer only ever sees Twilio's own STOP, START and HELP responses. Nothing is sent twice.
4. You get one text saying who it was and what happened. Your own texts are ignored.
5. Opt-outs and opt-ins are POSTed to your CRM or sheet webhook, if you set one.

### Setup steps
1. Add a Twilio credential (Account SID and Auth Token) and select it on the Twilio node.
2. Open **Your settings**: business name, your cell in +1XXXXXXXXXX format, whether to forward other texts, and an optional CRM webhook URL.
3. Activate the workflow and copy the production webhook URL.
4. In Twilio, open your number, and under Messaging set "A message comes in" to that URL with HTTP POST.

A number can only send incoming texts to one URL, so if another tool already handles your inbound texts, put this in front of it or merge the two.

## 1. Read the text
Twilio gets an empty TwiML reply within a second, which is all it needs.

## 2. Text the owner
Skipped for your own texts and, if you turn forwarding off, for everyday messages.

## 3. Update your CRM
Only for opt-outs and opt-ins, and only when crm_webhook_url is filled in.
